id.title: ID
id.description: A unique identifier for the import process. It is the same as the `import_id` provided in the request

user_id.title: User ID
user_id.description: A unique alphanumeric element that identifies the CARTO account user in the internal database

table_id.title: Table ID
table_id.description: A unique alphanumeric element that identifies the created table in the internal CARTO database

data_type.title: Data type
data_type.description: This element identifies the service type used to import the file

table_name.title: Table name
table_name.description: The final name of the created table in the targeted CARTO account. It usually has the same name as the uploaded file, unless there already exists a table with the same name (in this case, an integer number is appended to the table name)

status.title: State
status.description: A string value indicating the current state of the importing process

error_code.title: Error code
error_code.description: A number corresponding to the error code in case of failure during the import process, that is, when the `success` item has a `false` value

queue_id.title: Queue ID
queue_id.description: A unique identifier for the import process in the importing queue. It is the same as the `import_id` provided in the request

tables_created_count.title: Tables created counter
tables_created_count.description: The number of tables that the import process generated. For multi-file uploads, this value can be greater than one

synchronization_id.title: Synchronization ID
synchronization_id.description: This element has a `null` value when the import is not configured as a Sync Table

type_guessing.title: Type guessing
type_guessing.description: A boolean indicating whether field type guessing (for Excel and CSVs) is enabled or not

quoted_fields_guessing.title: Quoted fields guessing
quoted_fields_guessing.description: A boolean indicating whether type guessing of CSV fields inside double quotes is enabled for the data import

content_guessing.title: Content guessing
content_guessing.description: A boolean indicating whether content guessing and automatic geocoding is enabled for the data import

create_visualization.title: Create visualization
create_visualization.description: A boolean indicating whether the import process will create a map automatically or not. Its value corresponds to the import option `create_vis` chosen by the user

visualization_id.title: Visualization ID
visualization_id.description: A unique identifier for the map created in the import process. Only applies if `created_visualization` is set to `true`

get_error_text.title: Get error text
get_error_text.description: This element contains an error description to be outputted in case of a failure during the import process. It contains the error title and description, its source (`user` or `cartodb`), and troubleshooting details

display_name.title: Display name
display_name.description: Similar to `table_name`. For `url` uploads, it shows the name of the file. Otherwise, it shows the `import_id`

success.title: Success
success.description: A boolean value indicating whether the import process succeeded

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: A text field containing warning messages related to the import process, if applicable of the file. Otherwise, it shows the `import_id`

is_raster.title: Is raster
is_raster.description: A boolean value indicating whether the imported table contains raster data or not
